name: YeeSubscriptions – Subscriptions for WooCommerce
author: add-ons.org

sections.description:
YeeSubscriptions is the fastest, lightest subscription and recurring billing engine built natively for WooCommerce. Unlike heavy, expensive alternatives, YeeSubscriptions is designed with visual excellence, optimized for High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS), and provides a secure, self-hosted, and affordable foundation for your subscription business.

Whether you sell digital software, SaaS products, design assets, online courses, physical subscription boxes, or monthly services, YeeSubscriptions allows you to configure flexible subscription packages, collect payments automatically, and empower your customers with an intuitive self-service portal.

Demo : https://demo.add-ons.org/subscriptions/product/honda-cbr1000rr-r-sp-fireblade/
Demo Backend : https://demo.add-ons.org/demo/?clone_id=31
Documentation : https://add-ons.org/documentation-woocommerce-subscription-product-creation/
Pro Version : https://add-ons.org/products/yeesubscriptions/

The Affordable Alternative to WooCommerce Subscriptions

Why pay premium prices for basic subscription tools? YeeSubscriptions brings you the exact same powerful features—made affordable for businesses of all sizes.

  • Price: YeeSubscriptions Free vs. WooCommerce Subscriptions ($279/year) vs. Paid Alternatives ($100+/year)
  • 25+ Payment Gateways: Natively integrated (WooCommerce Subscriptions: Yes; Paid Alternatives: Moderate expansion beyond free)
  • Global Plans & Categories: Free (WooCommerce Subscriptions: $99/year addon)
  • Update Subscription Price for Existing (Old) Subscriptions: Free (WooCommerce Subscriptions: $99/year addon)
  • Custom Start Date: Free (WooCommerce Subscriptions: $89/year addon)
  • Automatic Billing on Schedule: Fully supported
  • Fixed Monthly Billing Date: Fully supported
  • Switch Plans with Automatic Adjustments (Proration): Fully supported
  • Retry Failed Payments (Dunning): Fully supported
  • Sign-up Fees + Recurring Charges: Fully supported
  • Customer Self-Service Portal: Fully supported
  • Suspend & Resume Subscriptions: Fully supported
  • Discounts for Recurring Payments: Fully supported
  • Flexible Product Options per Subscription: Fully supported
  • Compatibility with WooCommerce Memberships: Fully supported

Core Features

1. Supports 100% of WooCommerce Gateways

Unlike standard plugins that lock you into specific providers, YeeSubscriptions works flawlessly with any gateway that supports standard customer card tokenization or custom recurring hooks.
* Stripe Payments: Automatic card vaulting, along with native Google Pay and Apple Pay express recurring authorization. (WordPress plugin)
* PayPal Commerce: Full synchronization with PayPal Billing Plans and secure buyer tokens. (WordPress plugin)
* WooCommerce Square: Seamless integration with standard, secure merchant card tokenization. (WordPress plugin)
* WooPayments: Seamless integration with standard, secure merchant card tokenization. (WordPress plugin)
* Amazon Pay: Seamless integration with standard, secure merchant card tokenization. (WordPress plugin)
* Braintree: Seamless integration with standard, secure merchant card tokenization. (WordPress plugin)
* Authorize.Net: Seamless integration with standard, secure merchant card tokenization. (WordPress plugin)
* WooCommerce Payfast: Seamless integration with standard, secure merchant card tokenization. (WordPress plugin)
* Eway Payments: Seamless integration with standard, secure merchant card tokenization. (WordPress plugin)
* Mollie Payments: Seamless integration with standard, secure merchant card tokenization. (WordPress plugin)
* Paystack WooCommerce: Seamless integration with standard, secure merchant card tokenization.
* Manual & Local Bank Transfers: Flexible custom bank invoicing and automated reminders for offline payment workflows.
* Universal Gateway Compatibility: Support for all tokenization-ready and subscription-enabled processors.

2. Display Subscription Tables Anywhere via Shortcode

Effortlessly embed your pricing and subscription tables into any Post, Page, Widget, or Landing Page using a single line of shortcode. No coding required—perfect for boosting conversions at every touchpoint on your website.
* Shortcode Demo: https://demo.add-ons.org/subscriptions/subscriptions-shortcode/

3. Free Trial and Sign-up Fee

Boost acquisition rates by letting users experience premium plans risk-free with custom free trial periods (e.g., 7-day or 30-day trials). Once the trial ends, YeeSubscriptions automatically transitions them to a paid plan and processes payments seamlessly.
* Free Trial Demo: https://demo.add-ons.org/subscriptions/product/offer-free-trial-periods-for-subscribers/

4. Seamless Subscription Upgrades & Downgrades

Allow users to switch between plans (e.g., upgrading from Individual to Business) effortlessly at any time. The system automatically calculates prorated charges based on the remaining days of the current billing cycle, ensuring fair pricing and a smooth user experience.

5. Subscription Discounts Support

Take full control of your recurring promotions by creating discount codes dedicated exclusively to subscription products.
* Subscription-Only Restrict: Restrict standard coupons so they can only be applied to subscription items, preventing misuse on regular products.
* Smart Renewal Rules: Choose whether the coupon discounts the initial signup fee, applies to every recurring renewal, or expires after a set number of billing cycles.
* Boost LTV: Perfect for running targeted campaigns to acquire new subscribers or reward loyal customers with exclusive renewal discounts.

6. Product Installment Payments (Buy Now, Pay Later)

Boost your sales and average order value (AOV) by allowing customers to pay for high-ticket items in flexible, scheduled installments.
* Flexible Payment Plans: Break down the total product price into customizable installment cycles (e.g., 3 monthly payments, 4 bi-weekly payments).
* Optional Down Payments: Charge an initial deposit or sign-up fee upfront, followed by automated subsequent installment billing.
* Fixed-Term Subscription: Unlike ongoing renewals, the billing automatically stops once the total product price or the set number of installments is fully paid.
* Interest & Fee Management: Easily add a custom financing fee or offer 0% interest installments to incentivize quick purchases.
* Installment Payments Demo: https://demo.add-ons.org/subscriptions/product/installment-payments/

7. Subscription Discount Reports & Analytics

Make data-driven decisions with a powerful backend reporting system built directly into your dashboard. Track exactly how your promotional campaigns perform over time.
* Track Discount Impact on MRR: See how coupons and dynamic pricing affect your Monthly Recurring Revenue and Customer Lifetime Value (LTV).
* Detailed Coupon Analytics: Monitor which subscription coupons are performing best, total revenue generated, and total discounts given.
* Renewal vs. Signup Revenue: Break down your earnings to see how much revenue comes from initial signups versus automated ongoing renewals.
* Visual Charts: Clean, interactive charts and tables that help you visualize subscription growth trends at a glance.

8. Advanced Digital Download Controls

Perfect for selling premium software, digital assets, or media libraries. Our engine monitors file access based on real-time subscription health.
* Active Access Lock: Strictly restricts downloadable file access to customers with active subscription contracts.
* Automated Permission Revocation: Instantly revokes download permissions the exact moment a billing cycle goes on-hold, fails processing, or expires.
* Secure Asset Protection: Prevents direct link sharing and unauthorized file leaks, ensuring your digital products are fully protected.

9. Global Plans & Flexible Purchase Modes

Take full control over how your products are sold. Create universal subscription rules or customize purchasing flexibility on a per-product basis to maximize conversions.
* Global Subscription Plans: Save hours of setup time by creating universal billing plans (e.g., Weekly, Monthly, Yearly). Instantly apply these global rules to entire product categories or your whole store with a single click.
* Subscription-Only Restrictions: Lock specific items to be sold purely as recurring subscriptions, disabling one-time purchases entirely. Ideal for exclusive memberships, SaaS licenses, or ongoing services.
* Pure One-Time Payments: Run standard, fixed-price checkouts seamlessly alongside your recurring engine without database overhead or cart conflicts.
* Hybrid Billing Flexibility: Give buyers the ultimate freedom to choose between a one-time purchase or a recurring subscription on the exact same product page, allowing you to easily incentivize loyalty with custom discount choices.

10. Modern WooCommerce Architecture (HPOS & Blocks)

Built for the future of WordPress. Fully engineered to support WooCommerce’s latest core standards for ultimate database speed and modern conversion layouts.
* 100% High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) Ready: Moves subscription data into dedicated order tables, eliminating traditional wp_postmeta bottlenecks. Process thousands of concurrent renewals smoothly without server lag.
* Next-Gen Checkout Blocks Support: Drop your subscription products into WooCommerce’s modern, Block-based checkout seamlessly without breaking layouts or ruining the user experience.
* Real-Time Total Synchronization: Dynamically displays complex recurring totals, billing intervals, and upfront setup fees directly inside the modern checkout block totalizer.
* Seamless Enterprise Scalability: Keeps your admin dashboard, order search queries, and frontend checkout running at lightning speed, even with millions of subscription records.

11. My Account Self-Service Portal

Empower your subscribers and slash your customer support workload. Provides customers with an intuitive, built-in dashboard to manage their own commitments directly from their standard WooCommerce profile.
* Instant Contract Control: Allows clients to Suspend (Pause), Reactivate, or Cancel active contracts instantly with a single click, completely eliminating back-and-forth support emails.
* Seamless Payment Updates: Let users securely change, swap, or update their credit card and billing details on active subscriptions without disrupting their current cycle.
* Native WooCommerce Integration: Blends flawlessly into the standard WooCommerce “My Account” area, providing a clean, cohesive, and modern user experience.

12. Smart Automation & Developer Tools

Supercharge your store’s retention and custom integrations. A powerful suite of automated tools designed to protect your revenue and keep developers happy.
* Smart Email Reminders: Keep customers in the loop with automated, conversion-optimized email notifications for upcoming subscription renewals, successful payments, or expiration warnings.
* $0 Free Trial Safeguards: Offer zero-dollar trials safely. The engine automatically vaults and verifies the customer’s payment method upfront, preventing trial abuse and ensuring seamless conversion to paid cycles.
* Dunning Payment Retries: Never lose a subscriber to a temporary card decline. Intelligent retry logic automatically re-attempts failed transactions in the background (off-session) based on custom intervals before marking an order as failed.
* Webhook Hooks & REST API: Built developer-first. Fully equipped with custom WordPress hooks, actions, and native WP REST API endpoints to easily sync subscription data with external CRMs, ERPs, or custom webhooks.

Integration Compatibility

Subscription & Membership Plugin Compatibility

  • MemberPress: Automatically creates and synchronizes corresponding Subscription and Transaction statuses in MemberPress when customers purchase or renew via YeeSubscriptions.
  • WooCommerce Memberships: Synchronizes WooCommerce Memberships perks and access based on the active status of the YeeSubscriptions plan.
  • Ultimate Member: Directly synchronizes custom membership levels and WordPress user account meta information.
  • User Registration & Membership: Manages automatic account registration during the checkout process.
  • YeePurchaseCode: Automatically generates, activates, or suspends software license keys and purchase verification codes based on the active status or expiration of the recurring subscription.

Subscription & LMS (Learning Management System) Plugin Compatibility

  • LearnPress: Links WooCommerce products with LearnPress courses. Automatically enrolls students when a subscription is activated and unenrolls them upon expiration or suspension. Synchronizes periodic pricing display (e.g., $10.00/month) and redirects directly to WooCommerce Checkout.
  • LearnDash LMS: Links and synchronizes access to LearnDash Courses or LearnDash Groups.
  • Tutor LMS: Integrates Tutor LMS courses, manages student enrollment statuses (enrolled, suspended, or canceled), and synchronizes periodic pricing displays on course pages.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the yeesubscriptions folder to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin directly through the WordPress admin panel.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Configure your settings under WooCommerce > Settings > YeeSubscriptions.
  4. Start creating subscription products!
sections.faq:
Does YeeSubscriptions require custom payment gateways?

No. YeeSubscriptions is designed to integrate with standard, official WooCommerce payment gateways that support tokenization or customer card vaulting, such as WooCommerce PayPal Payments and WooCommerce Stripe.

Is YeeSubscriptions compatible with High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS)?

Yes! YeeSubscriptions declares full compatibility with HPOS to ensure fast database queries and frictionless scaling.

Can customers manage their subscriptions themselves?

Yes. Customers can suspend, cancel, and reactivate their subscriptions, and update their credit card details from the My Account > Subscriptions page.

Can I sell regular products and subscription products together?

Yes, absolutely. YeeSubscriptions fully supports mixed cart checkouts, allowing customers to purchase standard one-time products and recurring subscription products together in a single transaction.

Can I use shortcodes to display subscription tables?

Yes! YeeSubscriptions provides shortcodes to display pricing and subscription plans anywhere on your posts, pages, widgets, or landing pages.
